title: Custom HUD pack
description: This is an custom Hud pack made by obsidianDevelopment
body:
Upgrade your Minecraft experience with this clean and stylish HUD pack! Designed to make gameplay smoother and more enjoyable, this pack gives your UI a fresh new look while keeping everything simple and easy to read. Perfect for PvP, survival, Bedwars, Lifesteal, SMPs, and everyday gameplay.
✨ Features:
Clean custom HUD
Better hotbar and hearts
Smooth GUI design
Easy-to-read icons
PvP friendly layout
Works great for survival and multiplayer
Lightweight and performance friendly
Whether you’re fighting enemies, grinding resources, or exploring your world, this HUD pack helps your game look more modern and organized without changing the classic Minecraft feel.
Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock Edition and selected versions depending on the release. Download now and improve your gameplay with a brand new HUD style!
